_about: What the people you are moving say while you work. Pools by mood, then by event. {item} is the piece, {room} the room it landed in, {name} is Dana.

greet: Oh good, you're here. Tea's on, somewhere.
Hello hello. Mind the step, it bites.
You must be {name}. Marge said you were careful.
idle: I keep walking into the wrong room. New house.
Smells of paint still. I like it.
Do you want a biscuit? I've found the biscuits.
The light in here, in the afternoon. You'll see.
placed: I'd never have thought of there. It works.
Perfect, leave it just like that.
placed_good: Right room first time. You've done this before.
That's exactly where it goes. Thank you.
wrong_room: The {item}... in the {room}? Well. It's a choice.
Hm, I think the {item} wants the other room, but no rush.
A {item} in the {room}. We'll call it modern.
scuff: Oh. Oh, that's scuffed. Never mind, it's an old thing.
Was that always like that? It was not. It's fine.
A scratch. It gives it character, I suppose.
tipped: That was a lot of box at once.
stacked: Look at that. A proper tower.
Tidy. My dad would have liked you.
cat: There's the cat! I thought we'd left him.
Biscuit! How did you get in there?
caught: ...did that just go in your bag?
I saw that. I'll be mentioning that.
talk: Don't mind me. I'm just excited.
I'm trying not to get in the way. Am I in the way?
slow: No rush at all. I've got the kettle on.
Take your time. The house isn't going anywhere.
finish_good: It looks like a home already. You're a wonder.
finish_ok: That'll do us nicely. Thank you, {name}.
A couple of things in odd places, but it's ours now.
finish_bad: Well. We'll sort the rest ourselves, I suppose.
I'm sure it was a hard day. Thank you anyway.

greet: Shoes off, please. No, I'm joking. Mostly.
Right. Boxes are numbered. Do we read the numbers?
Before you start: the piano is not a shelf.
idle: That wall needs a picture. Not that picture.
I had a diagram. Where's my diagram.
Is it cold in here or is it me?
placed: Hm. Left a bit. No, back. Fine.
Straight, is it? It looks straight.
I'd have gone two inches over, but fine.
placed_good: Yes. That is where that goes. Finally someone listens.
wrong_room: The {item} does not live in the {room}.
Why is the {item} in the {room}? Who decided that?
{room}. For the {item}. I'll just... no. Carry on.
scuff: Scuffed. I knew it. I said it in the email.
Is that a chip? That is a chip.
That was mint this morning. Mint.
tipped: Did you just... tip it? Out?
stacked: Three high? Is three high safe?
Heaviest on the bottom, I assume.
cat: The cat was in a box. The cat was IN A BOX.
Is that the cat? Why is that the cat?
caught: Excuse me. That is mine. That is going in your bag.
I have an inventory, you know.
talk: Label side out, if you don't mind.
slow: We did say morning. It is no longer morning.
I'm not timing you. I'm just aware of the time.
finish_good: Well. I can't fault it. I tried.
Everything where it should be. I'll write to Marge. Nicely.
finish_ok: Mostly right. Mostly is not all, but mostly.
I'll be moving a few things. Only a few.
finish_bad: I have a list. I'll send the list.
That is not what I drew. I drew a diagram.

greet: You're late. Or I'm early. One of those.
Don't scuff the floor. Don't scuff anything.
Is that the whole crew? One of you?
idle: My brother-in-law has a van. Should've asked him.
What am I paying for, exactly?
Is the truck meant to look like that?
placed: Sure. Why not. Anywhere's fine, apparently.
Who taught you to carry? Nobody?
placed_good: Huh. Right room. First one all day.
wrong_room: Do you know what a {room} is for? Not a {item}.
A {item}. In the {room}. I'm not moving it, you are.
scuff: Brand new, that was. Brand new.
tipped: Oh, just throw it on the floor, why not.
stacked: If that falls, it's on you.
caught: Hey. HEY. That's mine. Put it back.
I saw that. Everyone saw that.
slow: The day's nearly gone, you know.
finish_ok: Half of it's in the wrong place, but sure.
finish_bad: I'm not paying for that. Well, I am, but I'm not happy.
Marge is going to hear about this.

greet: Is my room upstairs? Is it?
Hi! I'm helping. I'm not helping.
idle: I'm going to live in the box.
Can I keep a box? Just one?
Where does the telly go? The telly goes first.
This is MY room. I called it.
placed_good: That's the right room! I know all the rooms.
wrong_room: That's the {room}, silly. The {item} doesn't go there.
scuff: I didn't do it. I was here the whole time.
tipped: Do it again! Tip another one!
stacked: It's a castle! Can I go on top?
cat: The cat was in the box the WHOLE TIME.
caught: Mum, she's got your thing in her bag.
talk: Do you have a cat? We have a cat.
I can carry a box. A small one.
Is this your job? Every day?
slow: Are we done yet? Are we done yet?
finish_ok: My room's good. The rest is boring.
